title: The lane-archive guard's refusal names the add_repo access push route when it cannot read a lane's repo
why: lane-closes-after-records refused three times tonight on lane session-mailbox-followups because this session could not read the lane's second repo; add_repo fixed it at 09:08 CST. The owner asked (09:12 CST) that the fix be mechanical.
source: retrospective 09:13 CST Nov 13, owner ask 09:12 CST
note: Fix: when the archive guard cannot read a lane repo, its refusal names the act 'add_repo <owner>/<repo> access push, then retry', with the repo from the lane's cs-repo tag. Red first: a fixture lane whose repo read fails gets that remedy. The gap itself (archive-guard-child-repo-read) is a debt for the lane to file on main. 13:14 CST Nov 17 (coordinator relay, filed by triage 11): hook lane-closes-after-records refused archive_session twice, "the open pull requests of the lane's repo (shivinate7/mailaudit) could not be read". Measured by the coordinator: add_repo access read attaches nothing for a public repo, so the guard's gh could not read its PRs; access push fixed it. Owner 13:11 CST Nov 17 (page item 937 a, relayed): the guard reads a public repo's open PRs anonymously. REPLACED 14:20 CST Nov 17 (owner chat, relayed by the consultant; page item 940 b): consultant measured 14:15 CST that the cloud proxy refuses an unattached public repo even with no token (cli/cli 403, "add_repo"), so the anonymous read helps only local sessions. Owner: "just do the option that has you add in the repo you need". Now: NO anonymous read; the refusal says "add_repo <owner>/<repo> access push, then retry" (not read). Test-author red case first; review rounds apply. #3136 held at 764e0adf21 until rebuilt.
